messages:
maria_ae: Quick sync request: partner wants a small GKE + Terraform refkit for Arm GPUs (Ampere). Target: one-click demo for partners.

sam_k: I can do CI and multi-arch images. do we need separate tiles for marketplace?

partner_pm: Ideally single listing that points to the correct image per arch. GCP tolerates two linked tiles if needed.

jia_w: For Terraform example, keep it minimal. expose machine_type, node_count, and node_arch.

kevin_l: sample var list is fine. also add an outputs.tf with the ingress IP so demo scripts can curl it.

sam_k: CI plan: buildx with qemu for amd64+arm64 and run a lightweight inference smoke test. publish to ghcr.

maria_ae: Packaging checklist: README, manifest.yaml, terraform/example, smoke-test script, and a short rollback note.

ci_bot: Partner workspace created: https://redwood-internal/partners/spaces/gke-arm-refkit. Checklist attached. :white_check_mark:

kevin_l: smoke test command I'll add to repo: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://$DEMO_IP/serve -d '{"input":"test"}'`

jia_w: I'll add the terraform snippet to examples: `module "gke_inference" { source = "github.com/redwood-inference/refkits//gke-arm" machine_type = var.machine_type node_count = 1 node_arch = var.node_arch }`

sam_k: timeline: partner demo Friday. I'll aim to have CI green by Thursday EOD. ping if quota issues.

maria_ae: thanks all. quick check-in tomorrow 11am PT. :calendar:
